headline: Reports describe a Beijing–Tianjin–Hebei science-finance implementation plan
summary: Two reports dated Oct 21 state that Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei financial and science authorities released a regional implementation plan at the Oct 20 Financial Street Forum. They describe a six-part, 15-measure package spanning long-term capital, research and technology-transfer loans, cross-region financial services, technology insurance and cross-border finance. This development records the reported policy announcement on Oct 21; the signed plan was not recovered, and the reports provide no funding allocation, uptake or outcome evidence.
